The largest '''continent''' on the moon [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]], home to the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Species/Legends|species]], contained a high plateau. When explorers from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] reached the moon, they discovered a massive Galactic Republic symbol carved into the continent's plateau.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
